description: Read a Standard MIDI File: format, tracks, tempos, time and key signatures, track names, programs, and every note with its start and length in seconds, at most 5000 of them listed. Give midi_base64 or storage_id for a file of at most 1 MiB. Nothing is stored. No API key, no account and no sign up.

midi_base64.description: The file as standard base64, at most about 190 KB of file through MCP. For a larger file, store it with REST POST /services/v1/storage first and pass storage_id.

storage_id.description: A storage_id from store_file, from a previous tool result, or from REST /storage. Objects expire 24 hours after they were stored.

name: read_midi
title: Read a MIDI file
